hook: 6 seconds left on the clock changed the 2021 Meltwater Champions Chess Tour Finals entirely.

sections.voiceover: 6 seconds left on the clock changed the 2021 Meltwater Champions Chess Tour Finals entirely.
Teimour Radjabov faced Hikaru Nakamura during the 2021 Meltwater Champions Chess Tour Finals under extreme time pressure. Did Teimour Radjabov make the right call under pressure?
He played a move that backfired, but Nakamura immediately seized the advantage with a counter-attack.
Hikaru Nakamura secured 28 points in the final standings. Radjabov finished with 23.5 points after he was forced to resign the final game.
He resigned because he faced zugzwang, a situation where any move he made worsened his position.
